metaTitle: Custom Poly Spandex Sweaters & Cardigans | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom poly spandex sweaters and cardigans for your team. Soft, stretchy, and perfect for logo embroidery. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Poly spandex sweaters and cardigans offer a comfortable, flexible fit that holds its shape through repeated wear and washing. The spandex content adds stretch, making them ideal for employees who need freedom of movement, whether in the office or out in the field. These knits accept embroidery and screen printing cleanly, so your logo stays crisp on a fabric that moves with the wearer.
heroAltText: Custom poly spandex sweaters and cardigans with embroidered logo on a soft, stretchy fabric
